backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing mining project management with user profiles, subscription tiers (free/basic/premium), annual export limits, financial calculations, sensitivity analysis, access control, and Stripe integration.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old user profiles with monthly model limits to new profiles with annual model limits and separate export counters for the new three-tier subscription system.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including free/premium tier selection, export limits, chart export buttons, and subscription UI updates with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Summaries of frontend components including routing, authentication, project management, financial calculations, export functionality, subscription modals, and usage tracking for free/premium tiers.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH-based color palette for light and dark modes with mining-themed earth tones, plus print media queries for PDF export.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the ProFi Mine application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining routes for login, dashboard, payment success, and payment failure pages with RootComponent wrapper.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity authentication with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for initial user profile setup, collecting name, email, organization, and subscription tier selection (free or premium) with corresponding usage limits.
frontend/src/components/charts/CostBreak: Pie chart component displaying total cost breakdown by category (mining, processing, G&A, royalties, closure) with export functionality.
frontend/src/components/charts/Cumulativ: Line chart component showing cumulative free cash flow over project years with initial capex and export functionality.
frontend/src/components/charts/Productio: Bar chart component displaying yearly metal production in kilograms with export functionality.
frontend/src/components/common/InfoToolt: Reusable tooltip component with help icon that displays informational content on hover.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Main application header with branding, project name, subscription tier display, usage tracking, and action buttons for save/load/login.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportTab: Export interface tab providing CSV and PDF export options with free tier usage limits and warnings.
frontend/src/components/guide/Glossary.t: Searchable accordion-based glossary component displaying mining and financial term definitions.
frontend/src/components/guide/UsageGuide: User guide tab with table of contents sidebar and main content area displaying guide sections and glossary.
frontend/src/components/inputs/CostStruc: Renders a form section for mining project cost inputs including initial/sustaining CAPEX, mining/processing/G&A costs per tonne, royalties, and cost escalation settings. Uses ProjectContext to manage state and displays tooltips with glossary definitions.
frontend/src/components/inputs/DynamicAr: A reusable component that renders a dynamic array of numeric inputs with add/remove year buttons, displaying values in a responsive grid layout. Used for multi-year schedules like ROM tonnage and commodity prices.
frontend/src/components/inputs/EconomicP: Renders input fields for economic parameters including inflation rate, discount rate, tax rate, and a dynamic commodity price forecast array. Integrates with ProjectContext and displays glossary tooltips.
frontend/src/components/inputs/Financing: Provides input fields for financing parameters including equity ratio and interest rate. Uses ProjectContext for state management and displays glossary tooltips.
frontend/src/components/inputs/InputsTab: Main container component that organizes all input sections (Reserves/Production, Economic Parameters, Cost Structure, Financing) within a Card layout for the project inputs tab.
frontend/src/components/inputs/ReservesP: Renders input fields for ore reserves, grade, recovery rate, stripping ratio, and a dynamic ROM tonnage schedule array. Uses ProjectContext and displays glossary tooltips for each field.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout component that wraps the application with ThemeProvider, renders the router Outlet, displays a Toaster for notifications, and includes a footer with branding and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/layout/RootCompo: Top-level component that checks authentication and user profile status, conditionally displays the ProfileSetupModal for new authenticated users, and renders the AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentF: Displays a payment failure screen with error reasons, offering buttons to retry payment or contact support. Uses Card components for layout and navigation hooks.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentS: Displays a payment success confirmation screen, invalidates user profile queries to refresh subscription status, and provides a button to navigate back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/project/ProjectL: Modal dialog for loading and deleting saved mining projects, displaying project metadata (name, creation/modification dates) with load and delete actions.
frontend/src/components/project/SaveProj: Modal for saving mining projects with name input, subscription tier usage tracking, and upgrade prompts when monthly model limits are reached.
frontend/src/components/projections/Cash: Scrollable table displaying cash flow statement with operating cash flow, CAPEX, closure costs, free cash flow, and cumulative FCF across project years.
frontend/src/components/projections/Inco: Scrollable table showing income statement with revenue, OPEX, royalties, EBITDA, taxes, and net income for each year of the mining project.
frontend/src/components/projections/Proj: Main projections tab component that orchestrates display of summary KPIs, financial tables (income/cash flow statements), and charts (cumulative cash flow, production, cost breakdown).
frontend/src/components/projections/Summ: Table displaying key financial metrics including NPV, IRR, ROI, life of mine, average EBITDA, and payback period with color-coded positive/negative indicators.
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Scen: Comparison table showing base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios for NPV, IRR, ROI, and LOM with edit buttons to modify each scenario.
Dialog component for editing scenario adjustments (base, optimistic, pessimistic) with input fields for commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, CAPEX, and OPEX percentage changes.
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Sens: Interactive controls with sliders for adjusting key mining variables (-20% to +20%) and displays adjusted NPV, IRR, and ROI results compared to base case.
Main tab component that combines SensitivityControls, SensitivityTornado chart, and ScenarioComparison into a unified sensitivity analysis interface.
Renders a horizontal tornado chart using Recharts to visualize the impact of ±20% variations in key variables on NPV.
frontend/src/components/subscription/Sub: Modal dialog for displaying subscription tiers, current usage limits, and initiating Stripe checkout for Premium tier upgrade ($235/year for 300 models).
frontend/src/config/stripe.ts: Exports the Stripe publishable key for frontend payment integration.
frontend/src/constants/glossary.ts: Defines a glossary object mapping mining and financial terms (ROM, NPV, IRR, CAPEX, etc.) to their explanatory descriptions.
frontend/src/constants/guideContent.ts: Provides structured guide content with sections covering application overview, getting started steps, input parameter explanations, and calculation methodologies for the mining financial model.
frontend/src/contexts/ProjectContext.tsx: Provides global state management for project inputs, financial calculations, project metadata (name, ID), and subscription tier information (usage limits, exports remaining). Integrates with backend mutations for saving/loading projects and queries user profile data.
frontend/src/contexts/ScenarioContext.ts: Manages three scenario types (base, optimistic, pessimistic) with adjustable parameters (commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, capex, opex) and calculates financial results (NPV, IRR, ROI, LOM) for each scenario based on percentage adjustments to base inputs.
frontend/src/contexts/SensitivityContext: Handles sensitivity analysis by applying percentage adjustments to key variables (commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, capex, opex) and generates tornado chart data showing the impact of ±20% changes on NPV for each variable.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control with admin token from URL params, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChartExport.ts: Exports Recharts SVG elements to PNG images by converting SVG to canvas, drawing on white background at 2x resolution, and triggering browser download with timestamped filename.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Mutation hook that calls the backend to create a Stripe checkout session with shopping items, success/cancel URLs, and returns the parsed session ID and checkout URL for payment processing.
frontend/src/hooks/useExcelExport.ts: Generates CSV export of financial model data including KPIs, input assumptions, production schedule, income statement, and cash flow analysis; checks export limits via backend actor and decrements export count on successful export.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and context provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePdfExport.ts: Hook that manages PDF export functionality by checking export limits, decrementing export count via actor, and triggering the browser print dialog with user instructions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, mining projects, and Stripe configuration data through the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with mining-themed earth tone color variables for light/dark modes and print media styles that isolate and format the projections tab content for PDF export.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page with tabbed interface for Inputs, Projections, Sensitivity, Export, and Guide sections, wrapped in Project and Scenario context providers with authentication guard.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Landing page with branding, feature highlights, and Internet Identity login button that redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/types/external.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file for external type definitions.
frontend/src/utils/calculations.ts: Financial calculation engine that computes 10-year mining project projections including production, revenue, OPEX, EBITDA, cash flows, NPV, IRR, ROI, and payback period based on project inputs.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides utility functions for formatting currency (USD), percentages, numbers, and dates using Intl.NumberFormat and Date APIs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document showing implemented features for tiered pricing (Free and Premium), export limitations, chart export buttons, and subscription usage displays.
